description: Rewrite the Product specification UI sketching and audio sketching Claude Skills and portable Prompts as paired English canonical instructions. Their durable Product output must follow document_language while fixed technical names and placeholder conventions remain stable.
acceptance_criteria: Product specification UI and audio workflows use natural English canonical instructions
All three workflow pairs produce durable prose in document_language
ASCII conventions filenames and _placeholder_ prefixes remain stable
Native and portable variants preserve equivalent behavior and boundaries
notes: Human acceptance passed on 2026-08-26. Product specification, UI sketching, and audio sketching now use canonical English instructions across paired Claude Skills and portable Prompts while durable prose follows document_language. Stable Product patch keys, modes, ASCII conventions, UI paths, sfx/bgm identifiers, and _placeholder_ filenames are preserved. Automated verification: all 25 repository tests passed; all three native/portable workflow bodies are byte-for-byte equivalent below their canonical headings; JSON validation and git diff checks passed. Fresh-context review restored canonical handling for missing, invalid, and migration-sensitive document-language configuration and the complete standalone Tailwind HTML scaffold contract. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F017, must_fix: 0, suggest: 0, acceptable: 3).
